featured.name: Switch List — Yard Switching Sim
featured.blurb: A free, open training simulator for railway conductors: read the yard, line the road, call PULL / SPOT / KICK, and win in the fewest engine moves. Every mechanic cites a Canadian Rail Operating Rule — built straight out of my own time working freight.
points: Line switches and call moves on a live yard canvas
Two scores — Moves (the goal) and Joints (couplings)
“Watch optimal” replays the fewest-moves line in slow motion
19 jobs, each machine-verified solvable at par before it ships

projects.name: CROR Trainer — Grande Prairie
projects.blurb: A browser study tool for CN freight conductors on the Grande Prairie yard, grounded in the January 2025 Canadian Rail Operating Rules: rule drills, an animated switching sim and puzzle, an interactive yard board, signal reading, and a step-by-step radio walkthrough.

projects.name: Star Charter Pro
projects.blurb: Pilot a survey probe with heavy, drifty momentum, trace each constellation's blueprint on the atlas plate, and refit your instruments every third plate — dodging asteroids, black holes, and drifting space-fauna. A single-file roguelite built in this site's own night-sky style.

projects.name: Echo Bat — Night Harvest
projects.blurb: A bat in the dark, harvesting glowing fruit by sonar. Your voice paints the cave, then the dark takes it back. A mobile-first, single-file canvas game. Part of the Star Charter collection.

projects.name: Sentinel-Pro
projects.blurb: A read-only intelligence cockpit for ES & NQ futures: live order flow, volatility, structure, and macro news on one screen, with a data-free Discord feed. Self-hosted, no cloud — it watches the market and never touches it.

projects.name: Warcraft III — The Codex
projects.blurb: Custom survival and maze maps scripted in Lua — including a browser-playable homage to Coin Survival you can run right now.

projects.name: Diablo — Act 1
projects.blurb: A single-file canvas action-RPG — a vertical slice from town through the moor and the den to Blood Raven, with three classes and D2-style safe-zone map generation.

projects.name: Wave Survival
projects.blurb: A slice-based tower-defence game — economy, a tech tree, escalating waves, and a multi-map campaign, built one playable slice at a time.

projects.name: The Boys' Bots
projects.blurb: Node + discord.js bots for the group server — a token-leak fun-police and a Groq-powered personality bot. Small, useful, self-hosted.

projects.name: Bonnie Day
projects.blurb: A multi-page concept site for a Wolseley café — menu, story, and visit pages, built mobile-first.

projects.name: Garwood Grill
projects.blurb: A one-page concept site for a Pembina Hwy diner — menu, hours, reviews, and tap-to-call, in a warm old-school style.

projects.name: Hoagie Boyz
projects.blurb: A one-page concept site for a South Osborne sub shop.
